name: app-guardian
description: Security guardrails for vibe coders: hashed passwords, JWT + refresh tokens in cookies, HTTPS, rate limits on every endpoint, zero secrets in code, and more.

interface.shortDescription: Build apps with security baselines enforced by default.
interface.longDescription: Makes your coding agent write secure-by-default apps: Argon2id password hashing, short-lived JWTs with rotating refresh tokens in HttpOnly cookies, HTTPS/HSTS, rate limits on every endpoint, input validation, authorization checks, and zero secrets in code. Ends every task with a security report.
defaultPrompt: Add secure login to this app.
Audit this project against the security guardrails.
